person.headline: Healthcare cybersecurity leader | Security operations, resilience, and executive risk communication
person.summary: Cybersecurity leader with ten years across Army cyber operations and civilian security roles. Builds resilient security operations, leads high-stakes incident response, and translates technical risk for executives and boards.

positions.title: Director of Cybersecurity
positions.summary: Head of cybersecurity for a healthcare IT company handling PHI for more than two million patients. Reports to the CISO and leads security operations, incident response, and resilience.

achievements.statement: Built the SOC team from 0 to 12 analysts, achieving 24/7 coverage within six months.
Reduced mean time to detect from 72 hours to under four hours through SIEM tuning and automated triage.
Protected patient-care continuity during a ransomware event by leading recovery from offline backups and restoring critical clinical systems within 41 hours.
Briefs the CISO monthly on operational risk and the board audit committee quarterly on security posture.

positions.title: Cyber Operations NCO
positions.summary: Led cyber defense operations and incident-response activities in high-trust environments.

achievements.statement: Led cross-functional response exercises that improved escalation discipline and operational readiness.

education.institution: University of Texas at San Antonio
